facts.fact: The cathedral combines Romanesque and Gothic architecture with a predominantly Baroque interior. Its building programme began in the eleventh century, before the establishment of Portugal as a nation. The guide does not turn the page’s uncertain earlier-site tradition into fact.
facts.location: Main monument description, first three paragraphs.
